hostname rt-w05
!
fhrp version vrrp v3
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip address 198.51.100.2 255.255.255.0
 ipv6 address 2001:db8:0:10::2/64
 vrrp 1 address-family ipv4
  address 198.51.100.1 primary
  priority 110
  timers advertise 2000
  vrrpv2
  exit-vrrp
 vrrp 2 address-family ipv6
  address fe80::1 primary
  address 2001:db8:0:10::1/64
  priority 110
  timers advertise 500
  exit-vrrp
 no shutdown
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 192.0.2.2 1
!
end
